title: Professional Scrum Master (PSM)
overview: The Professional Scrum Master (PSM) course is designed to provide participants with a deep understanding of Scrum and the role of a Scrum Master. It covers Scrum principles, roles, and practices, and emphasizes the development of skills necessary for facilitating Scrum teams and guiding Agile transformations. The course prepares participants for the PSM certification exam and provides practical insights for effective Scrum Mastery.
audience: Scrum Masters and aspiring Scrum Masters.
Agile Coaches and Scrum Team members.
Project Managers and team leads involved in Scrum projects.
Professionals seeking advanced knowledge and certification in Scrum.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of Scrum concepts and practices.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises to apply Scrum principles in various scenarios.
Case Studies: Real-world examples and challenges of Scrum implementation.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore Scrum roles and best practices.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate readiness for the PSM certification exam
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a thorough understanding of the Scrum framework and the role of the Scrum Master.
To develop skills for facilitating Scrum processes and coaching Scrum teams.
To prepare participants for the Professional Scrum Master (PSM) certification exam.
To equip participants with techniques for leading Agile transformations and managing Scrum projects.
